name: graphon
description: Object storage your coding agent can set up, fill, and wire into your app.

interface.longDescription:
Graphon is object storage with an S3-compatible API and a JSON API.
This plugin gives your coding agent three things: the Graphon MCP server,
the Graphon CLI, and skills that teach the agent how to use them.

With the plugin installed, you can ask your agent to create a bucket,
upload files, add file uploads to your app, or move an existing bucket
into Graphon. The agent picks the right interface for each job: MCP tools
for control-plane work, the CLI for local files and secrets, and an S3
SDK for the code it writes.

The agent signs in with OAuth on its first call. The plugin stores no key.
When your app needs a key, the agent puts it where your project keeps
its secrets, so the key never appears in the transcript.
defaultPrompt: Set up Graphon storage in this project.
Move this app's file uploads to Graphon.
Copy my S3 bucket into Graphon and check every file.
